description: Golden vectors for the sixteen VSA operations gHashTag/trinity re-exports, as the pinned owner executes them; replayed through the elementwise functions of the spec, generated to C
generator: tools/trinity_vsa_compat.py vectors (a Python statement of the owner semantics; the pseudo-random trits come from this tool's LCG, not from the owner's PRNG)

operations.bind: len_max(la, lb) trits; out[i] = trit_bind(a[i] or 0, b[i] or 0)
operations.bind_zero_identity: the variant classified separately: len_min trits; out[i] = trit_bind_zero_identity(a[i], b[i])
operations.bundle2: len_max(la, lb) trits; out[i] = trit_bundle2(a[i] or 0, b[i] or 0)
operations.bundle3: len_max of the three; out[i] = trit_bundle3(a[i] or 0, b[i] or 0, c[i] or 0)
operations.bundle_n: 0 vectors: empty; 1: the vector; 2: bundle2; 3: bundle3; more: trit_sign of the sum over the longest length
operations.cosine_similarity: dot = sum of trit_bind over len_min; norms = sqrt of the trit_nonzero counts; 0.0 unless cosine_defined
operations.dot_similarity: 0.0 when len_max is 0, else dot / len_max
operations.hamming_distance: sum of trit_differs(a[i] or 0, b[i] or 0) over len_max
operations.hamming_similarity: 1.0 when len_max is 0, else 1 - hamming_distance / len_max
